title: The Last Hollow Again
author: Z. M. Yarrow
blurb: Wendell Oyelaran, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
